title: Cyclic orbit charts over a fixed strict local regular base
statement: Let $R,H$ be commutative rings in one universe and $\iota:R\to H$ a ring map. Assume $H$ is strictly henselian local (henselian with separably closed residue field), $H$ and $H/(\iota(g))$ are regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme], and $\iota(g)$ is a nonzerodivisor in the maximal ideal of $H$, for $g\in R$. Let $n>0$ be invertible in $R$, put $U=D(g)\subset\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $j:Y\to U$ be finite etale [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Write $p=j\circ\iota_U$. Put $A=R[T]/(T^n-g)$ and $V=D(g)\subset\operatorname{Spec}A$. Suppose there is an isomorphism $Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R}V\cong\coprod_{\operatorname{Fin}d}V$ [def-pc-fibre-product] commuting with the projections. Then there are $m\in\mathbb N$ and positive integers $e(k)$ indexed by $\operatorname{Fin}m$, each dividing $n$, and an isomorphism over $\operatorname{Spec}H$ from $Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R}\operatorname{Spec}H$ to $D(\iota(g))\subset\operatorname{Spec}(\prod_k H[T]/(T^{e(k)}-\iota(g)))$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sbc-strict-local-root-orbit-descent] to obtain m, stabilizer subgroups K(k), and theta over H to the puncture of the product of the actual fixed subalgebras.

Transport invertibility of n from R to H along iota. Apply [lem-sbc-strict-local-root-invariants] to each K(k). Set e(k)=K(k).index; these are positive divisors of n. Take the finite product of the H-algebra equivalences supplied by that lemma.

Spec of the inverse product equivalence gives an isomorphism of spectra over H. Its preimage of the basic open D(h) is D(h), since it fixes h. Restrict it using Scheme.Hom.preimageIso and Scheme.isoOfEq. Spec.map_comp and algebra compatibility give the projection equation. Compose with theta, using associativity, to obtain gamma and its required equation. This is proved explicitly by root_fixed_puncture_iso and the final Lean calculation.

theorem root_split_strict_local_orbits
    (R H : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (ι : R →+* H)
    [IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing H] [IsRegularLocalRing H]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (H ⧸ Ideal.span {ι g})]
    (hg : IsSMulRegular H (ι g)) (hgm : ι g ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal H)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n ∧ IsUnit (n : R))
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R)
    (j : Y ⟶ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))
    (hj : j ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) = p)
    [IsFinite j] [Etale j] (d : ℕ) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap R A g)
    ∀ (δ : pullback p (V.ι ≫ q) ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ V.toScheme),
      δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 V.toScheme) =
        pullback.snd p (V.ι ≫ q) →
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (e : Fin m → ℕ),
        (∀ k, 0 < e k ∧ e k ∣ n) ∧
        let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m,
          AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (ι g))))
        let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap H (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (ι g)))))
        let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
          (algebraMap H (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (ι g))) (ι g))
        ∃ γ : pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) ≅ V.toScheme,
          γ.hom ≫ V.ι ≫ q = pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))
